test: Unchanged core + OpenAL OpenSL + stb + JNI + EGL/GLES1 + AssetManager native shared-library link
result: Both normal and cheat native shared libraries built with --no-undefined and whole-archive core linkage
probe_cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(HeavyMachAndroidIsolationAudit LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
get_filename_component(HM_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(HM_BUILD_VALIDATION_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${HM_ROOT}" core-build EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(LIBTYPE STATIC CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_UTILS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_NO_CONFIG_UTIL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_BACKEND_WAVE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_REQUIRE_OPENSL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${HM_ROOT}/vendor/openal-soft" openal-build EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
foreach(kind IN ITEMS Normal Cheat)
 add_library(HMAndroid${kind}Probe SHARED probe.cpp)
 if(kind STREQUAL "Cheat")
  set(HM_PROBE_CORE HeavyMachValidationCore)
 else()
  set(HM_PROBE_CORE HeavyMachCore)
 endif()
 target_include_directories(HMAndroid${kind}Probe PRIVATE "${HM_ROOT}/vendor/openal-soft/include" "${HM_ROOT}/vendor/stb")
 target_link_options(HMAndroid${kind}Probe PRIVATE -Wl,--no-undefined)
 target_link_libraries(HMAndroid${kind}Probe PRIVATE -Wl,--whole-archive ${HM_PROBE_CORE} -Wl,--no-whole-archive OpenAL EGL GLESv1_CM android log)
endforeach()
